title: For Fans of Breaking Bad
intro: Ordinary men standing at the edge of something they cannot undo. Every frame asking how far is too far.

films.title: No Country for Old Men
films.blurb: The Coens shot only 250,000 feet of film where a production this size burns 700,000, and it shows: nothing is wasted, least of all mercy. Josh Brolin's welder finds a case of drug money in the West Texas desert, and Javier Bardem's Anton Chigurh comes for it with a coin and a cattle gun. It won four Academy Awards including Best Picture, and it still refuses to give you the showdown you are waiting for.
